content.short: ODOS is an advanced DEX aggregator with proprietary Smart Order Routing across 900+ liquidity sources on Mantle and 30+ other chains.
content.description: ODOS is a next-generation DEX aggregator powered by proprietary Smart Order Routing (SOR) algorithms that find optimal execution paths across hundreds of decentralized exchanges and liquidity pools simultaneously. Unlike simple aggregators, ODOS can split orders across multiple DEXes and handle complex multi-hop routes to maximize savings on any swap. Supporting Mantle and over 30 other blockchain networks, ODOS has processed billions in trading volume and is a key liquidity aggregation layer for sophisticated DeFi users.
